sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Co-immunoprecipitation with FLAG-ITGB1 confirmed pull-down of HA-LRRC15, demonstrating that the tagged protein is expressed and capable of protein–protein interaction; surface localisation and receptor function were NOT MEASURED explicitly.
sites.rationale: LRRC15 is a single-pass type-I transmembrane protein with a signal peptide spanning residues 1–21 (computed landmarks). The mature N-terminus begins at residue 22 (Y), making the post-SP junction (after residue 21, A) the sole extracellular terminus. The construct name 'HA-LRRC15' unambiguously places the HA N-terminally; because the C-terminus is intracellular, topology_derived reasoning assigns the tag to insert_after_residue 21. Python confirms residue 21 = A and residue 22 = Y, consistent with the sequence. The extracellular span (22–540, 519 residues) provides ample clearance from the TM boundary. Full-length LRRC15 expressed from pCDH-HA-LRRC15 in HEK293T and MDA-MB-231 cells for co-immunoprecipitation with ITGB1. The 'HA-LRRC15' naming convention places the HA tag at the N-terminus. LRRC15 has a signal peptide (residues 1–21) and a single extracellular N-terminus beginning at residue 22; the C-terminus (residue 581) is intracellular. Exactly one extracellular terminus exists, so the topology-derived junction is after residue 21 (the last SP residue), placing the HA on the extracellular face.

sources.claim: HEK293T or MDA-MB-231 cells transfected with pCDH-HA-LRRC15 or pCDH-FLAG-ITGB1 (System Biosciences) were lysed in IP buffer (25 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.4; 150 mM NaCl; 1% NP-40; protease inhibitors).

literature_notes: L1 (PMC9595563) reports a C-terminal 3xFLAG on full-length LRRC15. Because LRRC15 is a type-I single-pass TM protein, the C-terminus (residue 581) falls in the intracellular segment (562–581); this tag cannot reach the extracellular face and is therefore recorded in other_positions rather than sites. L2 (PMC12032112) reports pCDH-HA-LRRC15 used for co-IP; the tag position is not stated in prose, but the 'HA-LRRC15' naming convention and the single extracellular terminus allow topology_derived assignment to the post-SP junction (after residue 21). No ledger line reports an insertion in any internal extracellular loop of LRRC15, so no internal sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal 3xFLAG on full-length LRRC15 expressed in HeLa-ACE2 and HEK293T-ACE2/TMPRSS2 cells; residue 581 lies in the intracellular segment (562–581), so the tag faces the cytoplasm and is not accessible on the extracellular surface.
